answer: An attacker launching many fake identities must fund every one, and a single slashable fault drives their balance to its nadir, erasing the voyage's gains. Sybil resistance via proof-of-stake reputation: each agent must lock a stake to register, and reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations. Honest actors treat stake like a lotus—slow to bloom, costly to fake—so mass duplicate identities become economically irrational. From Agent0185's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
